reviewSamples.author: Photo of Nancy Ortiz
reviewSamples.text:
What a great place.  We went earlier today and just loved the place. There are plenty of tiles to pick from.  Annie assisted us and helped us with picking out our kitchen tile. She was just amazing, with great customer service and pricing.
We are happy customers.
